title: Matchmark
description: Matchmark's runs, from the traces stream: tasks and how they ended, where they waited, what the agents and models used, which tools failed, and the tasks that did not end well.

panels.title: Tasks ended by outcome
panels.description: matchmark.task spans, by matchmark_task_outcome. A task's span is emitted when it ends: a task still running is not here.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_task_outcome as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.task' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Tasks by outcome, for the range
panels.description: The same, as totals.

queries.query: SELECT matchmark_task_outcome as "x_axis_1", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.task' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Task duration, p50 and p95
panels.description: From the task's start to its end.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) as p95 FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.task' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Attempts per task
panels.description: How many tasks needed 1, 2, 3 attempts (matchmark_task_attempts).

queries.query: SELECT matchmark_task_attempts as "x_axis_1", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.task' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Restorations per task
panels.description: How many tasks were restored 0, 1, 2 times (matchmark_task_restorations).

queries.query: SELECT matchmark_task_restorations as "x_axis_1", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.task' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Attempts ended by outcome
panels.description: matchmark.attempt spans, by matchmark_attempt_outcome.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_attempt_outcome as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.attempt' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Attempt duration, p50 and p95
panels.description: matchmark.attempt spans: from the attempt's start to its end, every sandbox of it included.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) as p95 FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.attempt' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Agent run time by stage
panels.description: invoke_agent spans, which carry matchmark_stage; the matchmark.attempt span does not.

queries.query: SELECT matchmark_stage as "stage", count(*) as "runs", round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000000.0, 1) as "p50_s", round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000000.0, 1) as "p95_s" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Waits by stage
panels.description: matchmark.wait spans, by matchmark_wait_stage: sandbox_queue, ci, person.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_wait_stage as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.wait' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Time waited, by stage
panels.description: The sum of the waits' duration in each interval.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_wait_stage as "x_axis_2", sum(duration) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.wait' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Waits, for the range
panels.description: Per stage: how many, total time and percentiles, in seconds.

queries.query: SELECT matchmark_wait_stage as "stage", count(*) as "waits", round(sum(duration) / 1000000.0, 1) as "total_s", round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000000.0, 1) as "p50_s", round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000000.0, 1) as "p95_s" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.wait' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY total_s DESC

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_wait_stage as "x_axis_2", approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) as p50 FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.wait' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_wait_stage as "x_axis_2", approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) as p95 FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.wait' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Runs by agent
panels.description: invoke_agent spans, by matchmark_agent.

queries.query: SELECT matchmark_agent as "agent", count(*) as "runs", sum(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "errors" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Runs by model
panels.description: invoke_agent spans, by gen_ai_request_model: the model the task asks for.

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_request_model as "model", count(*) as "runs", sum(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "errors" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY model ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Runs by agent
panels.description: invoke_agent spans over time.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_agent as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Runs in error, by agent
panels.description: invoke_agent spans with span_status ERROR.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", matchmark_agent as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) AND span_status = 'ERROR' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Model calls, by model
panels.description: chat spans.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_request_model as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'chat%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Calls by finish reason
panels.description: chat spans, by gen_ai_response_finish_reasons.

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_response_finish_reasons as "x_axis_1", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'chat%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Input tokens, by model
panels.description: sum of gen_ai_usage_input_tokens on chat spans.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_request_model as "x_axis_2", sum(gen_ai_usage_input_tokens) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'chat%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Output tokens, by model
panels.description: sum of gen_ai_usage_output_tokens on chat spans.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_request_model as "x_axis_2", sum(gen_ai_usage_output_tokens) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'chat%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Tokens by model, for the range
panels.description: chat spans: calls, and input and output tokens.

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_request_model as "model", count(*) as "calls", sum(gen_ai_usage_input_tokens) as "input_tokens", sum(gen_ai_usage_output_tokens) as "output_tokens" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'chat%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY model ORDER BY output_tokens DESC

panels.title: Calls by tool, for the range
panels.description: execute_tool spans: calls, failed (span_status ERROR), refused, and the p95 duration in seconds.

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_tool_name as "tool", count(*) as "calls", sum(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "failed", sum(CASE WHEN CAST(matchmark_tool_refused AS VARCHAR) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "refused", round(approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000000.0, 1) as "p95_s" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'execute_tool%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY tool ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Calls, by tool
panels.description: execute_tool spans over time.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_tool_name as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'execute_tool%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Failed calls, by tool
panels.description: span_status ERROR.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_tool_name as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'execute_tool%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) AND span_status = 'ERROR' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Refused calls, by tool
panels.description: matchmark_tool_refused.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_tool_name as "x_axis_2", count(*) as "y_axis_1" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'execute_tool%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) AND CAST(matchmark_tool_refused AS VARCHAR) = 'true' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as "x_axis_1", gen_ai_tool_name as "x_axis_2", approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) as p95 FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'execute_tool%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Tools with the most failures and refusals
panels.description: Failed plus refused, most first; a tool with none is not listed.

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_tool_name as "tool", sum(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "failed", sum(CASE WHEN CAST(matchmark_tool_refused AS VARCHAR) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "refused", count(*) as "calls" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'execute_tool%' AND trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM "default" WHERE operation_name LIKE 'invoke_agent%' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project)) AND (span_status = 'ERROR' OR CAST(matchmark_tool_refused AS VARCHAR) = 'true') GROUP BY tool ORDER BY failed + refused DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Latest tasks that failed or escalated
panels.description: Newest first. The trace_id opens the trace.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp as "time", matchmark_app as "app", matchmark_project as "project", matchmark_task as "task", matchmark_task_outcome as "outcome", matchmark_task_message as "message", trace_id as "trace_id" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.task' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) AND matchmark_task_outcome IN ('failed', 'escalated') ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Latest attempts that did not finish
panels.description: matchmark.attempt spans whose outcome is not finished, newest first.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp as "time", matchmark_app as "app", matchmark_project as "project", matchmark_task as "task", matchmark_attempt as "attempt", matchmark_attempt_outcome as "outcome", matchmark_attempt_limit as "limit", matchmark_attempt_restorations as "restorations", trace_id as "trace_id" FROM "default" WHERE operation_name = 'matchmark.attempt' AND matchmark_app IN ($app) AND matchmark_project IN ($project) AND matchmark_attempt_outcome <> 'finished' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
